description: Foundation: scaffold Laravel 11 into a temp sibling folder and merge it into the project root so the result is ONE app rooted at d:\DATA - AHMAD\Project\kuya (design B.3); copy the existing static assets into public/; install Breeze (Blade stack); configure .env for daihatsu_db (root/empty password); generate the app key. This feature is a prerequisite for all others. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 only in that they build on top of it — it must run first.
steps: Scaffold into a TEMP sibling dir: `composer create-project laravel/laravel "d:\DATA - AHMAD\Project\kuya-laravel-temp"` (create-project refuses a non-empty target, so never run it in the project root).

Merge the temp app's contents into d:\DATA - AHMAD\Project\kuya WITHOUT overwriting the existing index.html, css/, js/, img/, or .agents/ (copy app/, bootstrap/, config/, database/, public/, resources/, routes/, artisan, composer.json, composer.lock, .env.example, vite.config.js, package.json, etc.). Then delete the temp folder.

Copy static assets into Laravel's public/: css/style.css -> public/css/style.css; all of js/ (13 modules + tailwind.config.js + data.js kept as a reference backup) -> public/js/; img/*.jpeg -> public/img/. Keep a reference copy of the original index.html at public/legacy/index.html. Leave the root-level index.html, css/, js/, img/ as untouched backups (user said preserve).

Install Breeze Blade auth: `composer require laravel/breeze --dev` then `php artisan breeze:install blade`. The npm build is optional (admin + public use the Tailwind CDN); if run, `npm install ; npm run build`.

Ensure .env exists (`Copy-Item .env.example .env` if absent) and set the DB block per design B.15: DB_CONNECTION=mysql, DB_HOST=127.0.0.1, DB_PORT=3306, DB_DATABASE=daihatsu_db, DB_USERNAME=root, DB_PASSWORD= (empty). Run `php artisan key:generate`.
Add a short README note (per design B.13/B.15): start XAMPP MySQL before migrating; seeded admin is admin@daihatsu.test / password.
acceptance_criteria: `php artisan --version` prints Laravel 11.x and `php artisan route:list` runs without a fatal error.
The static assets are served from public/: css/style.css, js/tailwind.config.js, and img/halo.jpeg each return HTTP 200.
Breeze is installed: `php artisan route:list --name=login` shows the login route.
.env points at daihatsu_db with root/empty password and a generated APP_KEY; `php artisan db:show` connects with no error (XAMPP MySQL running).
The original root-level index.html, css/, js/, img/ still exist untouched as backups.
verification: Start `php artisan serve` and confirm GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/css/style.css, /js/tailwind.config.js, /img/halo.jpeg each return 200
findings:
DONE. Laravel Framework 11.57.0 scaffolded (temp dir d:\DATA - AHMAD\Project\kuya-laravel-temp, merged into root, temp deleted). PHP 8.2.12, Composer 2.9.7, Node v24.15.0.

QUIRK 1 (composer audit blocks install): `composer create-project laravel/laravel` fails during dependency resolution because Composer 2.9.7 refuses laravel/framework 11.31+ over security advisories (block-insecure default). FIX APPLIED: added `config.audit.block-insecure=false` to composer.json, then `composer update`. The trailing non-zero exit on `composer require ... --dev` / `composer update` is only the final `composer audit` advisory report — vendor/ installs fully and artisan runs. Later features running composer should expect this exit code and ignore it (check vendor/autoload.php or `php artisan --version` instead).

QUIRK 2 (db:show fails on XAMPP, but connection is FINE): XAMPP ships MariaDB 10.4.32, NOT MySQL. `php artisan db:show` throws QueryException SQLSTATE[42S02] 'performance_schema.session_status doesn't exist' — this is a MariaDB-vs-MySQL incompatibility in db:show's thread-count query, NOT a connection failure. The PDO connection itself works: verified via `php artisan tinker --execute` returning DB name=daihatsu_db and server version 10.4.32-MariaDB. Later migrate/seed steps connect fine. Do NOT treat db:show's error as a blocker; use tinker/migrate to confirm connectivity instead. DB_CONNECTION defaults to mysql driver (works against MariaDB).

BREEZE (laravel/breeze v2.4.2, Blade stack): installed via `php artisan breeze:install blade` (ran npm install + vite build automatically; build output in public/build). Generated view paths for FEAT-003/auth work:
 - resources/views/auth/{login,register,forgot-password,reset-password,confirm-password,verify-email}.blade.php
 - resources/views/layouts/{app,guest,navigation}.blade.php
 - resources/views/dashboard.blade.php, resources/views/profile/* 
 - routes/auth.php (register GET+POST routes present here — must be removed per design B.7/B.13 for single-admin; register link lives in a nav/welcome, auth/login.blade.php uses layouts.guest).
 - Breeze layouts use Vite (@vite directives) + Tailwind-via-npm; design says public+admin should use Tailwind CDN instead, but npm build succeeded so @vite assets exist either way.
 - Controllers: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/* (AuthenticatedSessionController, RegisteredUserController, etc.), ProfileController.
 - login route confirmed via `php artisan route:list --name=login` (GET|HEAD login -> AuthenticatedSessionController@create).

ENV: .env set DB_CONNECTION=mysql, DB_HOST=127.0.0.1, DB_PORT=3306, DB_DATABASE=daihatsu_db, DB_USERNAME=root, DB_PASSWORD= (empty), APP_NAME="Daihatsu Sahabat". APP_KEY generated. storage:link created (public/storage -> storage/app/public). NOTE: default Breeze SESSION_DRIVER=database, CACHE_STORE=database, QUEUE_CONNECTION=database — these need the sessions/cache/jobs tables, so FEAT that runs migrate:fresh must include the framework migrations (they ship by default in database/migrations: 0001_01_01_000000_create_users_table, _000001_create_cache_table, _000002_create_jobs_table). Until migrate runs, hitting a route that uses the session store will error — expected before migration.

ASSETS: public/css/style.css, public/js/* (all 14 incl. tailwind.config.js + data.js reference copy), public/img/*.jpeg, public/legacy/index.html all present and served HTTP 200 (verified /css/style.css, /js/tailwind.config.js, /img/halo.jpeg => 200). Root-level index.html, css/, js/, img/ preserved untouched as backups.

GIT: project root was NOT a git repo; initialized one here and made the first commit locally (never pushed). .agents/ left in place.

README.md replaced with Indonesian project setup/bootstrap notes incl. seeded admin admin@daihatsu.test / password and the 'start XAMPP MySQL first' / PowerShell ';'-doesn't-stop-on-error warning.
